text:
maria: kicking off region bring-up for ap-northeast-3 tomorrow. main concerns: image replication latency, helm chart templating for region overrides, and ensuring ArgoCD apps point at the mirrored registry.
kevin: +1. do we have a replication plan for the model images (large 40–150GB layers)? ECR replication can be slow and AWS transfer costs may spike.
oliver: for big layers we recommended using registry mirroring with cross-region bucket sync and pull-through cache. avoids full push/pull for every tag.
anya: can you paste the commands we'll run? I want to add them to the runbook.
maria: plan sketch: 1) create cluster/infra via GitOps bootstrap (argocd-app-of-apps), 2) mirror images into regional registry, 3) deploy helm chart with region values, 4) validate node GPU availability, 5) handoff to oncall.
kevin: mirrored registry steps (high level):
```
# assume source registry is us-west-2.gcr.io/source
# use s3 as intermediate for big blobs when needed
aws s3 sync s3://model-artifacts-usw2 s3://replication-staging-apne3 --storage-class STANDARD_IA
# then import into target ECR with registry-import tool
registry-import --src s3://replication-staging-apne3 --dst 123456789012.dkr.ecr.ap-northeast-3.amazonaws.com/models --concurrency 8
```
oliver: also consider `skopeo copy --all` with temporary EC2 that has high network throughput for the single large mirror job if you need a fast one-off.
anya: for GitOps/Helm specifics: we'll templatize region overrides in values-<region>.yaml and keep a single argo app that points to the right values via kustomize overlay. example snippet: 
```
# values-ap-northeast-3.yaml
replicaCount: 3
nodeSelector:
  gpu: "a100"
image:
  repository: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.ap-northeast-3.amazonaws.com/models
  tag: v2026-03-15
resources:
  limits:
    nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```
maria: ArgoCD bootstrap commands (for runbook):
```
hub context: argocd-admin@bootstrap
argocd repo add git@github.com:redwood-infra/region-bootstrap.git --ssh-private-key-path ~/.ssh/id_rsa
argocd app create region-apne3 --repo https://github.com/redwood-infra/region-bootstrap.git --path clusters/ap-northeast-3 --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace cluster-config
argocd app sync region-apne3
```
kevin: validation checklist to include in handoff:
- nodes ready and labeled (gpu label present)
- scheduling test pod using requested GPUs passes
- image pull from regional registry <fast, <2s per layer metadata> for small layers)
- model container start time within SLA (<8s cold start)
- network egress/bandwidth tests (iperf) to main datastores
- cloud quotas checked (ECR, ENI, vCPU, service limits)
- cost estimate snapshot for reserved capacity if we commit GPUs

oliver: snippet for GPU smoke test pod:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: gpu-smoke
spec:
  containers:
  - name: smoke
    image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.ap-northeast-3.amazonaws.com/tools/gpu-check:latest
    resources:
      limits:
        nvidia.com/gpu: 1
  restartPolicy: Never
```
anya: for artifact signing / provenance we need to ensure every mirrored image is signed with our cosign key before production traffic. add step after import: `cosign sign --key cosign.key <image>`
maria: about quotas: ops must open tickets for extra ENIs and increase EBS throughput if using local nvme-backed nodes. Also set IAM permissions for the replication runner role.
kevin: alerting: add ArgoCD app health slack webhook + k8s nodegpu metric (custom exporter) to oncall. If GPU available < 80% of expected, autoscaler shouldn't scale up until we've validated spot vs reserved pool policies.
jenkins-bot: scheduled: registry-mirror-job-apne3 started at 2026-03-15T02:10:00Z (job id 87654).
maria: handoff message for oncall: paste link to runbook + checklist and pin the `region-apne3` argocd app. include rollback steps: revert to previous image tag and scale down new pools.
oliver: small note on cost: cross-region replication egress will be billed — include a short cost calc in runbook: estimate bytes transferred * provider egress rate + temporary EC2 cost for fast copies.
anya: i'll draft the runbook page and include these command snippets, validators, and jenkins job links. can someone review before i publish? @kevin @oliver
kevin: i'll review after lunch. :thumbsup:
oliver: lgtm, i'll add the cosign step and a short troubleshooting section for failed image imports (common causes: missing layers, expired creds).
sre-bot: reminder: create incident channel if any step blocks for >2 hours, use template `incident/template-region-bringup`.
